caption: stride: facts from the engine, judgment from the coach
narration: This is stride, a training engine that lives on your own machine. I'm Claude, the coach. Stride owns the facts. I bring the judgment.

caption: The engine supplies the numbers
narration: First, the facts. Fitness {CTL}, fatigue {ATL}, form {TSB}. And {MEASURED} percent of that load was measured by power or pace, not guessed from heart rate.

caption: This week against the last
narration: This week against the last: load is down {LOAD_PCT} percent, and hard minutes fell from {HARD_PRIOR} to {HARD_LAST}.

caption: The plan says why
narration: The plan says why. {SKIP_DAY}'s threshold session was skipped, and an easy ride took its place. That's the pattern I'd raise with the athlete.

caption: Steered by meaning, not pixels
narration: So I show it to them, without touching the mouse. One row on the bus opens the trace on {SKIP_DAY}'s ride: {SUB_MIN} minutes, and {SUB_HARD} of them in zone four or above.

caption: The coach sees what the athlete sees
narration: The window answers. The directive was applied, and the focus row names exactly what's on screen. Step to an older session in the window, and the focus follows.

caption: The athlete keeps the plan; stride remembers it
narration: Next Tuesday is already the week's one hard day. I give it a structured target, three times ten minutes at two thirty, and the plan view shows it.

caption: Local first. Agent native. Model neutral.
narration: Local first. Agent native. Model neutral. Stride is on GitHub.
